name: Wolf-Winter Bow (Lang Đông Cung)
lore: A horn-and-yew bow Hứa Vãn Cung bought from the bowyers of Cung Tiễn Thôn as a caravan guard, and carried on the three nights of 1190 (A064). On the third night he shot the grey pack-leader with it, and the bowyers have since refused to make another of its pattern. The string is wolf gut.
build_use: The warden-head's bow: accurate, piercing shots at the strongest foe.
made_by: the bowyers of Cung Tiễn Thôn
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: The Caravan Bell of the Wolf Nights (Lang Dạ Đà Linh)
lore: The lead wagon's bell of Trang Thiết Cước's caravan, which he rang for three nights in 1190 to keep the wagons together while the wolves circled. He gave his wagons to the wolves and his silver to the hall, and kept the bell.
build_use: The old caravan master's guard: a hard body and a rally for you.

name: Warden's Coat of Three Nights (Tam Dạ Tuần Bào)
lore: The wolf-hide and leather caravan coat he wore for the three nights of 1190, slashed in eleven places. The bowyers of Cung Tiễn Thôn stitched it with bowstring.
build_use: A body that comes back each breath through a long night.
